source: ESPN live injury report (site.api.espn.com/.../nfl/injuries) - see get_espn_injuries.py
methodology_note: Real, disclosed scope: confirmed Out/Injured Reserve players are shown with adjusted_projected_ppr=0.0 (a real fact - they won't play). Questionable players are flagged but NOT numerically adjusted - no real, fit model exists in this project for how much a game-status designation should reduce a projection, so none was invented. Backup players are NOT boosted for the same reason - no real model exists for how much workload/points a backup absorbs when a starter is out. This is a real, separate overlay - it does not modify player_props_2026.json, fantasy_rankings_2026.json, games_2026.json, or data/locked_predictions/.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.source_note: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison will require surgery on his thumb and will miss a few weeks, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.source_note: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.source_note: Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.source_note: out

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.source_note: Iosivas (thumb) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

players.name: Tyrell Shavers
players.source_note: The Bills did not activate Shavers (knee) from the reserve/PUP list, and he will not be available for Sunday's game against the Jets.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.source_note: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.source_note: out

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.source_note: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said that he's "hopeful" Wilson (finger) will be able to return from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.source_note: Jacobs (finger) has a "realistic chance" of returning to action Nov. 25 against the Rams following the Packers' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.source_note: Henderson (illness) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Will Shipley
players.source_note: The Eagles opened Shipley's (foot) 21-day practice window Monday.

players.name: Mo Alie-Cox
players.source_note: The Colts placed Alie-Cox (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: James Conner
players.source_note: Updating a previous report, Conner (foot) no longer appears to be a candidate to return from injured reserve to play Week 11 versus the Chiefs, according to Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com.

players.name: Zavier Scott
players.source_note: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.source_note: questionable

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.source_note: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bowers (ankle) is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "It's not as bad as we thought, but still a significant injury," Kubiak said.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.source_note: questionable

players.name: Geno Smith
players.source_note: Smith underwent tests Monday that didn't reveal a major injury to his left ankle, and he'll continue to be evaluated during the week before the Jets decide on his status for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.source_note: questionable

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.source_note: Coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that the Vikings expect Hockenson (wrist/chest) to make progress ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.source_note: Monangai (toe/thumb) was seen wearing full pads for the Bears' unofficial practice Tuesday, Adam Jahns of AllCHGO.com reports.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.source_note: The Buccaneers appear to be preparing for the possibility of Mayfield (foot) being sidelined for Sunday's game against the Lions, after the team signed Cooper Rush to the practice squad and signed Easton Stick to the 53-man roster Monday, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

players.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
players.source_note: questionable

players.name: George Holani
players.source_note: Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.
